basicProfile.name: Mai Tran Huu Hieu
basicProfile.tagline: 7 years of software development experience focused on React, frontend architecture, and building scalable systems in enterprise environments.

strengths: Design and build frontend architecture for large-scale enterprise systems
Build reusable component systems, field systems, and shared UI frameworks
Optimize React performance for complex screens and business flows
Work across frontend, backend integration, and database concerns
Lead code reviews, onboarding, and skill development within the team
Apply AI to improve engineering workflow, testing, and technical productivity

thinking.title: Simplicity first
thinking.description: Start with solutions that are simple, understandable, and maintainable before adding more complexity.

thinking.title: Clear trade-offs
thinking.description: There is no perfect solution. Every technical decision is a trade-off between cost, performance, scalability, and delivery speed.

thinking.title: System thinking
thinking.description: Care about consistency, reuse, and the long-term impact of technical decisions across the whole system.

thinking.title: AI as a support tool
thinking.description: Use AI to accelerate research, testing, and development while keeping technical accountability and engineering judgment in human hands.

experiences.title: Large Enterprise React Platform
highlights: Designed and optimized shared UI systems used across multiple business modules
Built reusable field systems, table systems, and dynamic configuration mechanisms
Reviewed code, onboarded new members, and supported developers working in a large codebase
Built testing workflows with Vitest, Playwright, and AI-assisted development practices

experiences.title: React Dashboard Platform
highlights: Started the project from scratch with Vite, TailwindCSS, and Redux Toolkit
Designed the frontend architecture and reusable systems for the dashboard
Improved performance with lazy loading, memoization, and better data flow design
Reduced production risk through clearer engineering and testing practices

experiences.title: React + Java Enterprise System
highlights: Contributed to a system migration from React 15 to React 16
Built both frontend and backend parts of business features
Worked directly with clients to analyze requirements and propose solutions
Implemented automation testing with Cypress and improved rendering performance

focus: Grow stronger in designing frontend systems at product scale
Strengthen foundations in computer science, JavaScript, and frontend internals
Improve technical leadership, mentoring, and technical communication

hero.supportingText: Focused on building frontend systems that scale, stay maintainable, and help teams work more effectively over the long term.

strengths.title: Building frontend systems that scale, stay maintainable, and grow sustainably.
strengths.description: A mix of hands-on experience, system thinking, and technical quality applied to solutions that fit real product and team needs.

thinking.title: Making technical decisions through context, trade-offs, and long-term value.
thinking.description: Prioritize clarity, maintainability, and practicality instead of chasing complexity that does not create proportional value.

experience.title: Building technical foundations that help teams move faster and stay more stable.
experience.description: Experience spans feature development, frontend system design, shared platform work, testing, and improvements to the software delivery process.
experience.cardDescription: Projects that represent experience across frontend architecture, reusable systems, delivery quality, and technical leadership.

goals.title: Continuing toward product-level engineering.
goals.description: The current focus is deeper frontend architecture, system design, stronger theoretical foundations, and stronger technical leadership in product environments.
goals.closingNote: Always aiming for solutions that are clear, practical, and valuable over the long term for both product and team.

contact.title: Let’s connect if you care about frontend, React, or software engineering.
